verses.gurmukhi: ੧੬ : ਗੁਰੂ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚੀ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 16 : guroo preet sabh to(n) u'chee hai

en.bdb: Highest is the love for Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੁ ਮੁਲਕੁ ਚਤੁਰੰਗ ਦਲ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: maal mulak chatura(n)g dhal dhuneeaa patisaahee|

en.bdb: If being master of army having four divisions (elephant, chariot, horse and infantry), country and the wealth;

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਸਭ ਖਲਕ ਉਮਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: ridh sidh nidh bahu karaamaat sabh khalak umaahee|

en.bdb: If having attraction for others due to possession of miracles through ridhis and siddhis;

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਹੁ ਹੰਢਣਾਂ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਗਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: chir jeevan bahu ha(n)ddanaa(n) gun giaan ugaahee|

en.bdb: If living a long life full of qualities and knowledge

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਸੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਚਿਤਿ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: horas kisai na jaaniee chit beparavaahee|

en.bdb: And if being enough powerful to care for nobody is still engrossed in dilemma,

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਦਰਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: dharageh ddoiee naa lahai dhubidhaa badharaahee|

en.bdb: He cannot have shelter in the court of Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸੁ ਘਾਹੀ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit_en: peer mureedhaa(n) pirahaRee paravaanu su ghaahee ||16||

en.bdb: Due to love for his Guru, even an ordinary grass cutter Sikh becomes acceptable.
